answer: Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. Work waits on the pigment until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wander of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the saffron of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
